items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: And, and, and, Red Allen, I filled in for Red Allen on most of his jobs.

ctx.x: Sometimes I was a leader and sometimes I -- now, now, now, I started working with Art Hodes/ I started working with Dixieland bands. Mostly with Art Hodes. I was a Dixieland man then.
And, and, and, Red Allen, I filled in for Red Allen on most of his jobs. So, I went to Paris --
At that time too, be-bop was emerging wasn't it?
